en.headline: Housing Society posts HK$1.338 billion surplus for third consecutive year
en.dek: Net assets reached HK$49.9 billion at end-March; more than 15,000 units expected to be completed over the next five financial years.
body: The Hong Kong Housing Society reported a surplus of HK$1.338 billion for the 2025/26 financial year, marking the third consecutive year of positive results.

Total income stood at about HK$4.548 billion against expenditure of about HK$3.21 billion. Net assets at 31 March 2026 reached HK$49.9 billion, up 3 per cent from a year earlier and the highest level since 2021/22.

Property sales contributed HK$738 million, mainly from the handover of more than 170 subsidised sale flats under dedicated rehousing estate projects. The Society said future completions would provide stable sales and rental income.

It expects more than 15,000 units to be completed over the next five financial years and said it would continue to manage resources prudently while exploring capital-market financing to support development.

zh.headline: 房協二零二五至二六年度盈餘十三點三八億 連續三年錄得盈餘
zh.dek: 截至三月底淨資產四百九十九億元，未來五個財政年度預計落成逾一萬五千個單位。
body: 香港房屋協會公布二零二五至二六年度年報，錄得盈餘十三點三八億港元，連續第三年錄得盈餘。
年內總收入約四十五點四八億元，總支出約三十二點一億元。截至二零二六年三月三十一日，淨資產值為四百九十九億元，按年增長百分之三，創二零二一至二二年度以來新高。
物業銷售收入七點三八億元，主要來自交付超過一百七十個專用安置屋邨項目的資助出售房屋單位。房協預期隨着多個項目陸續落成交付，可帶來穩定銷售及租金收入。
未來五個財政年度預計落成超過一萬五千個單位。房協表示會繼續審慎調配資源，並善用資本市場支持項目發展。
